title: The Wrathgate and Undercity
summary: The Wrathgate disaster breaks an offensive against the Lich King and sends Alliance and Horde toward the Battle for Undercity.
opening: Two armies faced the same enemy at Angrathar. What happened there fractured trust and carried the war back to Undercity.
reviewNote: Review the original cinematic and both factions' questlines. Later game versions changed or removed parts of the Undercity sequence. Editorial chapter research tasks retained here: Establish the Alliance and Horde forces approaching the Lich King's gate. Follow the cinematic event and immediate losses. Compare what each faction learns and whom each holds responsible. Reconstruct the Battle for Undercity from both quest perspectives.

chapters.title: The advance to Angrathar
chapters.body: Alliance and Horde forces approached Angrathar, standing before the Lich King’s gate beneath different banners.

chapters.title: At the Wrathgate
chapters.body: The disaster at the Wrathgate broke the offensive. Immediate losses changed the struggle and deepened the breach between its armies.

chapters.title: After the betrayal
chapters.body: Each faction sought an answer and laid responsibility from its own understanding. Shared loss did not produce shared trust.

chapters.title: The city below
chapters.body: The conflict returned toward Undercity. Alliance and Horde entered the battle carrying different purposes and the wounds of the gate.
